artworks.title: Un Jour de représentation a bénéfice...
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted from head to toe in an illustration standing side by side. The man on the left has a solemn expression and wears a dark long coat and a top hat. The man on the right appears more rotund, wears a dark suit with a white shirt underneath, and also a top hat. He holds a walking cane in his right hand. There is a partial view of a door in the background marked with the number '35', and a framed piece of paper with visible but indistinct text hanging on the wall. The background is a muted interior with subtle but textured shading suggesting walls and possibly seating in the far left.

artworks.title: A. Granier de Cassagnac
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man with exaggerated facial features and a humorous depiction of having a human upper body and a turkey's lower body. He is walking confidently up a set of steps, holding a flag that partially reads “Le Grano” and wearing a suit with a bow tie. There are several sketch-like bystanders behind him, and the background consists of stairs suggesting a staircase.

artworks.title: Pierre-Napoléon Bonaparte
artworks.description: The image captures a man walking with exaggerated features in the foreground. The man is slightly turned to the right, with one hand holding a slender, pointed object resembling a cane or walking stick, while the other hand is behind his back. His facial features are exaggerated, with a large head, prominent nose, and a bushy mustache. He has closely cropped dark hair and is dressed in a knee-length coat, striped pants, and simple shoes. Surrounding him are indistinct shadowy figures of other people engaged in conversation. The background is minimal, with a plain backdrop transitioning from lighter at the top to darker towards the bottom, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Ovide Remilly
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a caricature style, standing with arms raised and hands open. The person has exaggerated facial features, curly hair, and is wearing a suit. They are surrounded by animated dogs and other figures in the background.

artworks.title: Lannes, duc de Montebello
artworks.description: The image is a caricature of a person sitting on a bench. The individual's features are exaggerated, including a large forehead, prominent cheeks, deep-set eyes, and short hair with sideburns. They are wearing a black coat, white vest, and white pants, with no visible accessories. The background is minimal and nondescript.

artworks.title: Pierre Louis Parisis
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length caricature of a person with an exaggeratedly large head standing upright, facing towards the left. Their facial features include wide-open eyes, a bulbous nose, and a slightly open mouth. The person's hair is sparse and combed back. They are wearing a long, dark, striped robe that drapes down to the ground, and they hold a book under their right arm. Their left hand is holding a whip with multiple lashes. In the background, smaller figures can be seen in chaotic movement, appearing to cower or run away. The background is a simple, unadorned setting with no distinct features.

artworks.title: Le Constitutionnel contemplant l'horizon politique
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing on a round platform, holding a spyglass and facing towards the right. They wear a hat with two points and a large garment. Below the platform, a crowd of people are visible, some reading newspapers titled "La Gazette de France," "Le Siècle," "Le Charivari," and "La Presse." The background is neutral with shading indicating an outdoor or public space.

artworks.title: L'Artiste - Voila qui est terminé!...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio focusing on sculpture. The drawing showcases a scene within a studio with one person sculpting details on a head, while another person watches. A bust on a pedestal is to the side, with additional sculptures or tools present. Sketches and reliefs are displayed on the wall. The studio setting is traditional and cluttered with various artistic tools and items.

artworks.title: Suffrage universel (Universal Suffrage)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a large scale balanced by two unequal forces. On the left side of the scale, various caricatured figures sit huddled together. On the right side, a robed figure stands confidently, holding an urn labeled "SUFFRAGES UNIVERSELS" and a large scroll or plaque that says "VOTE." The scale is clearly tipped in favor of the standing figure. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to create depth and highlights the disparity between the two sides of the scale.

artworks.title: Faut pas s'plaindre de c'temps-la...
artworks.description: Two caricatured figures standing facing each other outdoors. On the left, a figure with arms down, wearing a flat cap, vest, shirt, and trousers. Their facial features are exaggerated with a wide grin and prominent eyes. On the right, another figure with arms crossed, holding a closed umbrella. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, long coat, and have pronounced features like a large nose, deep-set eyes, and sideburns or a beard. There are two baskets filled with flowers or fruit on the ground. The setting includes a hatched style suggesting rain with vertical lines for raindrops, and leafy foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Un Criminel!
artworks.description: The image depicts a cartoon-like drawing of two men shown in full body. Both men are walking side by side, with the first man extending his arm around the second man's shoulder. The first man has exaggerated facial features with pronounced eyes and a long, angular nose. He is wearing a cap and a long, loose-fitting coat. The second man, with similarly exaggerated features, has a shorter nose and wears a hat and a buttoned jacket. The first man holds a long stick or walking cane, while the second carries what appears to be a bottle. The background features a landscape with some foliage and trees, with the outline of a distant cityscape visible. The ground is shaded in a way that provides texture and depth to the image. The drawing includes rough, sketch-like lines and has an inscription in the corner.

artworks.title: Allons bon!... il parait... chasse réservée
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cartoonish figures. The figure on the left has an oversized head, bulging eyes, and a helmet; they are running towards the right with a startled expression. They are holding an object that resembles a large knife. Below this figure, a small dog is running. To the right, another figure with an elongated face and wearing a hat is shouting while raising one arm and holding an object in their other hand. The background consists of cloudy shapes and a barren landscape. The drawing style and expressions convey a sense of humor.

artworks.title: Les Tritons de la Seine
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of exaggerated human forms with large, distorted heads and elongated facial features. The figures are rendered in swirling, irregular lines. The oversized heads are reminiscent of caricatures. They appear to float or partially submerge in a liquid surface resembling a sea or lake. There is a small boat with two figures and one figure appearing to dive with legs in the air, suggesting boat riding and swimming.

artworks.title: Histoire d'un règne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bound figure between two cannons. The drawing depicts a central figure resembling a statue or person, shackled and wrapped in cords, with the word "FRANCE" above it. To the left and right of the figure are cannons. The left cannon has "2 DECEMBRE" written on it, while the right cannon bears the number "1870". The contrast between the bound figure and the cannons implies a sense of conflict or tension. The use of shading and linework gives depth to the image, enhancing the dramatic impact of the scene.

artworks.title: Ce que certains journaux appeleraient...
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a figure labeled "FRANCE" being prodded with a rifle by a soldier wearing a spiked helmet. The figure is approaching a ballot box labeled "URNE ELECTORALE." The posture of "France" suggests resignation or despair. The soldier appears aggressive and intimidating. The drawing style is satirical and exaggerated, indicative of a skilled caricature artist.

artworks.title: L'Ane et les deux voleurs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures grappling on the ground, with an equestrian figure in the background. The composition is dynamic and intense, showcasing a struggle on a rugged landscape with rolling hills. The foreground features a tussle between two figures, with one figure pinning the other to the ground. A rider on a horse moves away swiftly in the background, blending into the rugged landscape. The contrast between the foreground action and the distant rider adds depth and narrative to the image.

artworks.title: Ce char marchera toujours...
artworks.description: The image features a horse-drawn carriage labeled "RÉPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE" being pulled by three figures. The carriage is driven by a statue holding an urn inscribed with “VOTE UNIVERSEL.” The scene includes a cobblestone street, a stylized horse, and exaggerated features on the figures, conveying a sense of humor and social commentary. The style is reminiscent of lithograph caricatures from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Le Constitutionnel contemplant l'horizon politique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man on a pedestal looking through a telescope at a crowd of people reading newspapers. The man on the pedestal is holding a telescope, while the people below are engrossed in reading newspapers with headlines like "La Gazette de France," "Le Siècle," and "Le Charivari." The drawing features detailed pencil work emphasizing the textures of clothing and facial expressions.

artworks.title: Un Chemin dangereux
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures sliding down a steep incline, with a statue in the background. The figures are dressed in exaggerated fashion, struggling to maintain their footing as they descend. The slope appears to be fabric, emphasizing their instability. At the top, a statue labeled "Republique Francaise" stands with outstretched arms. The figures have exaggerated facial features and expressions, adding humor to the scene. The use of hatching and shading techniques creates depth and texture, making the drawing dynamic and lively.

artworks.title: C'est dangereux, la pêche à l'épervier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure entangled in a large net labeled "MONARCHIE". The scene is set against a blank backdrop. The figure appears to be caught within the mesh of the net. The net is made of scribbled lines. The drawing has a monochromatic palette. The text at the bottom is written in French. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical art.

artworks.title: Nous ne nous serions jamais douté tout de même...
artworks.description: Two men are depicted from head to toe, standing and engaging with each other. They are both wearing matching outfits resembling naval uniforms, including caps and belts. Their facial features are in a caricature-like style, with notable noses and chins in profile. The man on the left gestures upward with his left hand, while the man on the right holds a long object similar to a rifle, looking in the same direction. The background features lightly sketched lines suggesting a wall or building and an ornament-like figure above the men.

artworks.title: Décidément on ne peut pas...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing upright. The man on the left is leaning forward while the man on the right is holding a piece of paper or a map. Both men have exaggerated facial features, with prominent noses and lips, and wear spectacles. The man on the left has a bald head, while the man on the right wears a spiked military helmet. They are dressed in military-like attire with large shoulder pads and short pants. The man on the right is holding a large piece of paper. The background is plain with minimal shading, focusing on the figures.

artworks.title: Square Napoléon
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a graveyard scene with tombstones and cross-shaped silhouettes under a large moon in the night sky. Several gravestones are depicted, with inscriptions of places and dates of death. The style is monochromatic with emphasis on grey tones created by pencil strokes. Lighting and shading are used to highlight text and provide depth to the picture.

artworks.title: La paix a tout prix
artworks.description: The image depicts a man crouching or bending forward. He has intense facial features with a furrowed brow and a focused expression. He is wearing a long-sleeved outfit, grasping a rifle, while a hand holds a feather behind him. Another hand holds a scepter with a crown and an architectural dome below it. The background is minimal.
